choices: Do you know how he fell ill?

choices: Where do you get your Bloody Bracers from?

Fight Vanstrom Klause. Check the sidebar for more details.

Fight Vanstrom Klause. Protect from Magic. He has various special attacks indicated by what he says: My pets will feast on your corpse: A bloodveld will appear which you need to kill from a distance. Blood will be my strength: An orb appears that heals Vanstrom. Lure Vanstrom onto it. Stare into the darkness: Face away from Vanstrom. Once he hits 0hp, he'll heal to 200 and start summoning lightning bolts. Move off tiles where they appear.
